about: Clothing store: the street front (the clothes-store fascia over the shop window, two dressed mannequins under spot lamps), the shop room and the till; a shopper takes a folded cotton shirt off the wall shelf, pays at the till and walks out clean, then takes leather gloves and walks out unpaid: the clerk's line, the alarm on the shop-front bell box and a wanted level. Wearing the shirt has no harness verb and stays in the PR's manual steps. Points are building space (tools/buildings/pipeline/scenario.mjs); the shop front faces +z.
